title: Wall Mount Soap Dish Solid Brass 4.5-Inch Dottingham Collection | Venetian Bronze | Allied Brass
short_title: Wall Mount Soap Dish 4.5-Inch Solid Brass | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade your bathroom sink or shower area with a wall mount soap dish that keeps soap off the counter and within easy reach in Venetian Bronze, which presents deep, warm undertones with subtle golden accents, evoking European craftsmanship and timeless style. Crafted from solid brass, this Dottingham collection accessory uses concealed screw mounting for a clean, coordinated look.

Highlights:
- Venetian Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Concealed screw hardware for a neat, finished installation
- Includes brass soap dish holder and installation hardware
- Designed to coordinate with the Dottingham collection

Specs:
- Overall size: 4.5-Inch L x 3.5-Inch W x 3-Inch H; 5-Inch projection
- Weight capacity: 2 lb
- Product weight: 1.6 lb
- Mounting type: wall mount (assembly not required)
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
